nodes.description: Base.creator address set to msg.sender at deployment, used for master/admin authorization
BasicAuth.master privileged address initialized by InitMaster
BasicAuth.auth_list mapping granting external callers AuthAble privileges
MainCard global card library storing card structs and index list
MainChip global chip library with part managers and temp timers
MainBonus global bonus pool, day ratios and per-player bonuses
MainBag mapping from address to player bag inventories
Child reference to the Main contract used for external calls
Home mapping tracking last sign-in day per address
Caller-controlled address used throughout for auth and identity
Origin address used in BasicAuth OwnerAble and SetAuth/ClearAuth authorization
Block timestamp (now) driving day counting, expiry and randomness
Base constructor assigning creator = msg.sender
BasicAuth.InitMaster sets the master address with zero check
BasicAuth.SetAuth grants auth_list privileges, guarded by tx.origin/msg.sender check
BasicAuth.ClearAuth removes auth_list privileges, guarded by tx.origin/msg.sender check
BasicAuth.OwnerAble modifier requiring acc == tx.origin
Library insert shifting elements, contains erroneous incrementing loop
Library add computed value with overflow require
Library sub with underflow require
MainCard.AddNewCard adds a card, MasterAble restricted
MainChip.AddNewChip adds a chip and registers part manager, MasterAble restricted
MainBag.GainCard2 grants card chips either temporarily or permanently
MainChip.AddChipTempTime pushes expire time for a chip with timestamp check

MainBonus.ProfitByCard dispatches profits based on card profit type

MainBonus.AddStaticProfit books static ratio for duration given timestamp
MainBonus.AddDynamicProfit registers dynamic card profit over duration
MainBonus.RefreshDayBonus updates global bonus for elapsed days based on now
MainBonus.QueryPlayerBonus computes accrued player bonus up to a day
MainBonus.Withdraw computes and transfers player bonus, updating state
MainBonus.MasterWithdraw transfers contract surplus to master
MainBonus.AddBonus external AuthAble function adding to reward pools
Main.GainCard external entry granting and profiting a card

Child.GenRandom derives pseudo-random number from msg.sender, seed and now

Home.Withdraw external call proxying to g_Main.Withdraw(msg.sender)

selfdestruct executed in Child.kill destroying contract
acc.transfer(bonus) external value transfer in MainBonus.Withdraw
master.transfer(bonus) external value transfer in MasterWithdraw
address(g_Main).transfer(msg.value) external call in Child.AddBonus

acc.transfer(bonus) external value transfer in ImmediateProfit
target address parameter of SetAuth used to write auth_list
acc address parameter of MainBonus.Withdraw used as transfer recipient
bonus local variable in Withdraw holding computed payout amount
random parameter of Child.GenRandom used in entropy mix
r local variable in GenRandom derived from keccak256 of sender, seed and now
index parameter of IndexList.insert used as stored value

block.timestamp used as expire time comparison in AddChipTempTime

block.timestamp computes todayNo and day range in AddStaticProfit
block.timestamp computes todayNo and day range in AddDynamicProfit

normalization_plan.reason: target is only used to write auth_list inside SetAuth so it collapses into the SetAuth core function node
acc is the payout recipient parameter of Withdraw and carries no independent identity
bonus is a temporary computed amount inside Withdraw and merges into the Withdraw function node
random is an input argument used solely inside GenRandom randomness computation
r is a transient keccak256 result inside GenRandom and merges into that function node
index is only stored into the array by the unsafe insert loop inside IndexList.insert
